title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 431 (Vacancy in Tribunal or Appellate Tribunal not to invalidate acts or proceedings)

content.overview: No act or proceeding of the Tribunal or the Appellate Tribunal is invalid merely by reason of a vacancy or a defect in the constitution of the body.
content.glance: No act or proceeding of the Tribunal or the Appellate Tribunal is invalid merely by reason of a vacancy or a defect in the constitution of the body.
content.study: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 431 (Vacancy in Tribunal or Appellate Tribunal not to invalidate acts or proceedings). No act or proceeding of the Tribunal or the Appellate Tribunal is invalid merely by reason of a vacancy or a defect in the constitution of the body. Apply only the conditions, approvals, filings and penalties stated in the section. A rule made under the Act cannot contradict the section. Not a verified closure.

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: No act or proceeding of the Tribunal or the Appellate Tribunal is invalid merely by reason of a vacancy or a defect in the constitution of the body.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: The section cures formal defects. It does not cure a want of jurisdiction or a breach of natural justice.
